name: Comvergence
summary: Melbourne IP telephony + voice/data carrier (hosted VoIP, Internet connectivity, wholesale voice; Cisco SPA9000 provider); website live to 2021, redirected from 2024 (COMVERGENCE PTY LTD, ACN 116 560 742).

events.details: Communication service provider; hosted VoIP, IP telephony, Internet connectivity and wholesale voice. COMVERGENCE PTY LTD, ABN 83 116 560 742 (ACN 116 560 742), South Yarra VIC.

comvergence.net.au live with homepage captures through Mar 2021, then 301/302 redirects from 2024. The earlier 'defunct 2005-09' was a misreading of the site's '2005-2009' copyright range as a lifespan; COMVERGENCE PTY LTD (ABN 83 116 560 742) remains registered as active. Retail ISP homepage last seen Jun 2010 and webmail-only by Mar 2013; the B2B telco persists behind a login shell but its public ISP face died c. 2010-13, not 2020 or 2023.

refs.label: Homepage was webmail-redirect-only by 28 Mar 2013 (and through Sep 2017) — dead per webmail-only convention
2018-2020: bare VoIP firewall/forms stubs; only redirect shells from Feb 2021 onward
